electromagnetic.significance: Maximum amplitude crossing - full wave from Source to Sink

channels.name: Curiosity
channels.pairingDynamic: Oscillating pair - manifesting ideas meet dissolving structures

gateInterpretation.emSummary: Gate 11 spans the COMPLETE wave from pure potential (Heaven/-4) to pure form (Earth/+4). This is the most dramatic transformation possible in the 64 hexagrams - the full amplitude manifesting journey.
gateInterpretation.nameAnalysis: The I-Ching names this 'Peace' because it represents the complete resolution of potential into form. When the source pole fully manifests into the sink pole, there is completion - nothing remains in tension.
gateInterpretation.channelDynamic: With Gate 56 (dematerialising +3 → -2), creates an oscillating double-transformer. Ideas manifest then dissolve into new explorations - hence 'Curiosity'.

iching.wilhelm: When ribbon grass is pulled up, the sod comes with it. Each according to his kind. Undertakings bring good fortune.
iching.interpretation: Interconnected potentials at Source come together

exaltation.blackBook: The serendipity of being in the right place at the right time. The nourishment derived from being with those who share the same goals and aspirations.
exaltation.whiteBook: The gift of finding those who will value your ideas.

detriment.whiteBook: The sense that no one will value their ideas.

emInterpretation.positionMeaning: First contact with the Source pole - entry to the field of pure potential
emInterpretation.lineFunction: Tuning to the field of connected potentials before selecting what to manifest
emInterpretation.emKeynote: First contact with the field of connected potentials

iching_em.analysis: The image of interconnected roots directly maps to the electromagnetic principle that the Source pole contains undifferentiated but connected potentials.

ra_em.analysis: 'Attunement' describes the entry-level task: tuning to the field of potential before selecting what to manifest.

planetaryLogic.analysis: Moon exalted (receptive timing at Source), Mars detriment (force disrupts attunement to potential).

iching.wilhelm: Bearing with the uncultured in gentleness, fording the river with resolution, not neglecting what is distant, not regarding one's companions: thus one may manage to walk in the middle.
iching.interpretation: Expanding scope and tolerance before the great crossing

exaltation.blackBook: The recognition that without vigilance and risk, peace can lead to stagnation and collapse. The imagination applied to ensuring the understanding of achieved values.
exaltation.whiteBook: A sense of boredom overcome through the imagination.

detriment.blackBook: The resorting to factionalism to satisfy the ego's need for action.
detriment.whiteBook: Provoking with ideas to escape boredom.

emInterpretation.positionMeaning: Development within the Source pole - building capacity before threshold crossing
emInterpretation.lineFunction: Expanding the range and tolerance of what potential can hold
emInterpretation.emKeynote: Expanding the scope of potential before the great crossing
emInterpretation.shadow: Factional action (Mars) fragments what must remain unified

iching_em.analysis: The emphasis on breadth and tolerance directly supports building capacity at Source before the full-amplitude crossing.

ra_em.analysis: 'Rigour' partially fits - development requires discipline. But the EM frame emphasises expansion, while Ra emphasises vigilance against stagnation. Different emphases, same direction.

planetaryLogic.analysis: Neptune exalted (imagination expands potential), Mars detriment (factional action fragments what must remain unified).

flags: MODERATE_TENSION - Ra emphasises vigilance while EM emphasises expansion

iching.wilhelm: No plain not followed by a slope. No going not followed by a return. He who remains persevering in danger is without blame. Do not complain about this truth; enjoy the good fortune you still possess.
iching.interpretation: Peak of potential accepting the inevitability of manifestation

exaltation.blackBook: The acknowledgment that peace is transitory. The internal renewal to maintain strength and alertness.
exaltation.whiteBook: The realization that ideas come and go.

detriment.blackBook: The tendency to appreciate harmony to the point of delusion. The belief that beauty is eternal. Fiddling while Rome burns.
detriment.whiteBook: A pleasure in ideas that have no real application.

emInterpretation.positionMeaning: Completion of the inner trigram - peak of origin domain before zero-crossing
emInterpretation.lineFunction: Maximum development at Source, accepting that the crossing is inevitable
emInterpretation.emKeynote: The peak of potential, accepting the inevitability of manifestation
emInterpretation.shadow: Attachment to harmony (Venus) prevents necessary transformation

iching_em.analysis: The text precisely describes the pre-threshold moment: potential cannot remain potential forever. 'No plain not followed by a slope' - the crossing follows Source.

ra_em.analysis: 'The Realist' perfectly names the line-3 function: accepting that manifestation must occur.

planetaryLogic.analysis: Pluto exalted (transformation is inevitable, embrace it), Venus detriment (attachment to harmony prevents necessary change).

iching.wilhelm: He flutters down, not boasting of his wealth, together with his neighbor, guileless and sincere.

exaltation.blackBook: The sage, that in the extreme, can teach harmony to the tone deaf. The ability to reach out and attract the alienated.

detriment.blackBook: The Guru, whose most valued wisdom is intentionally limited to a few.
detriment.whiteBook: Ideas which can only be grasped by the few.

emInterpretation.positionMeaning: Entry to the outer trigram - first contact with destination domain after zero-crossing
emInterpretation.lineFunction: Arrival at Sink (+4), where manifested ideas can now be transmitted
emInterpretation.emKeynote: First contact with manifest form; humble arrival at the Sink
emInterpretation.shadow: Self-focused radiance (Sun) restricts transmission of form

iching_em.analysis: 'Fluttering down' precisely describes energy arriving at Sink. The humility reflects that form is receptive, not assertive.

ra_em.analysis: 'The Teacher' fits entry to manifest form: ideas that have crossed into form can now be transmitted to others. Teaching requires manifestation.

planetaryLogic.analysis: Moon/Venus exalted (receptive grace at Sink), Sun detriment (self-focused radiance restricts transmission).

flags: NOTE - Multiple planets in exaltation (Moon + Venus) - rare pattern suggesting rich expression

iching.wilhelm: The sovereign I gives his daughter in marriage. This brings blessing and supreme good fortune.
iching.interpretation: Development through relational distribution of form

exaltation.blackBook: The motiveless nurturing of the disenfranchised to ensure harmony.

detriment.blackBook: The withdrawing from direct contact, where giving is a form of defence.
detriment.whiteBook: Giving away ideas out of a sense of insecurity.

emInterpretation.positionMeaning: Development within the outer trigram - building capacity in destination domain
emInterpretation.lineFunction: Developing the relational network of manifest form through distribution

iching_em.analysis: Marriage/giving develops the relational network of manifest form. Form at Sink naturally distributes and connects.

ra_em.analysis: 'Philanthropist' = one who gives form to others. Development at Sink is distributive.

planetaryLogic.analysis: Moon exalted (nurturing distribution), Mercury detriment (mental withdrawal prevents relational development).

iching.wilhelm: The wall falls back into the moat. Use no army now. Make your commands known within your own town. Perseverance brings humiliation.
iching.interpretation: Full manifestation recognizing its own transience

exaltation.blackBook: The inner balance to accept transition. The innate awareness that all forms are transitory.
exaltation.whiteBook: The realization that ideas lead to change and are changeable.

detriment.blackBook: Adaptability in its most negative manifestation. The speculator who profits at the expense of others in times of peace or war.
detriment.whiteBook: The realization of what idea is of value in any situation.

emInterpretation.positionMeaning: Completion of the outer trigram - full arrival at destination, gate completion
emInterpretation.lineFunction: Maximum manifestation at Sink (+4), recognizing that dissolution begins
emInterpretation.emKeynote: Full manifestation recognizing its own transience
emInterpretation.shadow: Exploitation (Jupiter) at completion disrupts natural dissolution

iching_em.analysis: 'The wall falls back into the moat' describes the principle that maximum form (+4) is inherently unstable - it must either distribute or dissolve.

ra_em.analysis: 'Adaptability' names the Line-6 wisdom: at completion, rigidity fails. The cycle will turn.

planetaryLogic.analysis: Neptune exalted (accepting transience), Jupiter detriment (expansion/profit at completion disrupts natural dissolution).

strongAlignments.note: All sources agree: manifestation is inevitable
'Wall falls' = form cannot hold at maximum

marsDetriment.analysis: Mars appears in detriment twice in the inner trigram (Source). Force disrupts potential - especially harmful at -4.

moonExaltation.analysis: Moon appears in exaltation three times - receptive timing supports the full manifesting journey, especially at entry points and distribution.

flags.description: Ra emphasises 'vigilance against stagnation' while EM emphasises 'expansion of scope' - different emphases, same direction
Multiple planets in exaltation (Moon + Venus) - rare pattern suggests rich expression at this position

summary.gateFunction: Complete manifesting journey from Source (-4) to Sink (+4)
summary.thresholdMeaning: Total mode-shift from Heaven to Earth
summary.outerTrigramTheme: Arriving, distributing, and accepting transience of form
summary.nameSignificance: 'Peace' reflects electromagnetic completion - when potential fully manifests, tension resolves. But Line 6 reminds us this peace is temporary.

sources.iching: Wilhelm/Baynes translation via James DeKorne's Gnostic Book of Changes
